## Theme submission

**Theme name:**

**Author:**

---

### Checklist

- [ ] The `.audiotheme` file is valid JSON matching the `AudioThemePackage` v1 format
- [ ] `version` is `1`
- [ ] `accentColor` is a valid hex color (`#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA`)
- [ ] `background.type` is not `image` or `video` (machine-local paths don't travel)
- [ ] `name` and `accentColor` are set
- [ ] File is placed in `themes/<slug>.audiotheme`
- [ ] `index.json` entry added with `id`, `file`, `name`, `author`, `description`, `accentColor`, `previewColors`

---

*Submitted via [Audion Theme Browser](https://dupitydumb.github.io/audion-theme/)*
